reason: DSM answers error 403 whenever `user_group_type` is absent, so the generated command could never succeed on a first call. The parameter is required in practice, and making every caller discover that from an opaque error code is worse than defaulting to the common case.
validated_outcome: `folder permissions --name <share>` succeeds with no extra flag against a live DS415+, and an explicit `--user-group-type local_group` still overrides it.
